original_test_intent: Read the chassis aggregate health status through Redfish and verify the reported Health and State conform to the platform's expected health policy.
original_method: Discover the correct chassis resource, validate its complete Status object and enum values, then evaluate raw Health/State plus only approved child/OEM context under a versioned policy and transient-state window without clearing evidence.
manual_activity: Provide the firmware-matched chassis Status schema and expected Health/State policy, including Warning/Critical/Unknown/Absent meanings, transient grace windows and authorized child or OEM context for explaining aggregate health.
safety_requirements: Preserve existing fault and log evidence
No hardcoded credentials or TLS bypass
Do not clear SEL or faults
Do not reset or power-cycle the chassis
Preserve raw enum values before normalization
Fail closed on invalid, contradictory, stale or wrong-resource status
agent_execution_scope: Validate resource identity and Status schema
Use secret-backed read-only access over verified TLS
Apply approved enum and transient rules
Retrieve child/OEM context only when authorized
engineer_actions: Approve transient, unknown and child-context semantics
Confirm no fault clear or reset is part of this case

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Status object is relevant, but the command hardcodes ChassisId, bypasses TLS, discards resource identity/context and lacks the external policy needed to interpret Health and State.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Follow the advertised chassis URI, securely retain the complete response and evaluate raw Status enums under the supplied health and transient-state policy, adding only approved explanatory context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Health Status read-only scope and 15/10 timing remain; ChassisId, expected enums, transient window and child/OEM scope are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use schema-validated raw Status evidence and a deterministic policy evaluator that preserves Unknown, Warning, Critical and transient states instead of flattening them to OK/not-OK.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces the placeholder and unconditional YES with resource discovery, an external health policy, raw plus normalized evidence and explicit contextual limits.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates one chassis aggregate status snapshot or approved observation window; it does not prove every component healthy, stimulate faults or validate alarm clearing/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Aggregate status can lag child resources or reflect maintenance and boot transitions; querying only `.Status` can obscure the identity and context required to interpret it.

project_override_considerations: If the project defines OEM aggregate fields or a cross-resource health roll-up, record the standard Status object and apply the supplied mapping without hiding disagreement. A child-level OK must not overwrite a non-OK aggregate value or vice versa.
expected_evidence: Advertised chassis URI and Status schema
HTTP status and complete response hash
Raw Health/State and normalized policy result
Authorized child/OEM context and any disagreement
No clear, acknowledge, reset or power action

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, generic read-only Procedure and specification-match Criteria consistently describe Health Status inspection. The absent endpoint and policy are incomplete rather than conflicting.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The chassis schema, health policy and transient semantics are definable package inputs, so the case is REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Makes the aggregate-health check auditable by retaining raw enums and applying an explicit status policy, while preventing evidence destruction through the source's log-clear step.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish Status commonly contains State and Health values with different meanings: an enabled resource can still be warning or critical, and Unknown is not equivalent to OK. Aggregate health may also lag or summarize multiple child faults, so resource identity, timestamp and approved context matter. A transient observation window can be legitimate during boot or maintenance, but it must be supplied rather than invented. Clearing SEL or faults before reading status would remove explanatory evidence and undermine the test.
